name: braintrust
summary: I successfully fetched the Braintrust evaluation quickstart and installed the required Python SDKs (`braintrust`, `openai`, `autoevals`) — pip completed with `Successfully installed autoevals-0.3.0 braintrust-0.34.0`. I wrote the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly as the quickstart specifies, adapting it to route through the Braintrust Gateway using the provided `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`. However, the sandbox cannot establish TLS connections to any Braintrust endpoint: `curl` to `gateway.braintrust.dev`, `www.braintrust.dev`, `api.braintrust.dev`, and `api.braintrust.ai` all fail with `Connection reset by peer` during the TLS handshake, while other HTTPS endpoints like `api.openai.com` do respond (HTTP 421). This network-level restriction blocks the SDK from reaching Braintrust entirely, so I could not execute the eval run or report scores.
